item.meaning: A fraction whose denominator is a power of 10 (10, 100, 1000, etc.).
item.source_context: Chapter 4: Another Peek Beyond the Point

item.description: Extending place value to the right of the decimal point: Tenths (1/10), Hundredths (1/100), Thousandths (1/1000).
item.source_context: Chapter 4: Another Peek Beyond the Point

item.rule_text: Multiply factors as whole numbers, then place decimal point so decimal places equal the sum of decimal places in the factors.
item.source_context: Chapter 4: Another Peek Beyond the Point

item.rule_text: Multiply both dividend and divisor by the same power of 10 to convert the divisor into a whole integer before dividing.
item.source_context: Chapter 4: Another Peek Beyond the Point

item.description: Multiplying a decimal by 10^n shifts decimal point n places to the right; dividing by 10^n shifts decimal point n places to the left.
